claim: 1996 Agreement, Article VI(1): within two kilometres of the LAC, neither side shall 'open fire' (or blast, hunt with guns or explosives, use hazardous chemicals); routine firing on small-arms ranges is excepted. evidence.quote: Neither side shall open fire, cause bio-degradation, use hazardous chemicals, conduct blast operations or hunt with guns or explosives within two kilometers from the line of actual control. This prohibition shall not apply to routine firing activities in small arms firing ranges.

method: Searched the text of S01, S02, S03 and S05 for 'carry', 'arms', 'weapon': hits are only III(2) (armaments to be limited), the small-arms-range exception, and smuggling of arms (2013).
notes: The absence is our own text search (see notes in myths.md M1).
